name: Monte Gazlowe
summary: At Ratchet, Monte Gazlowe keeps a neutral port open to traders from every side. He founded the town with the fortune he earned as the Horde’s chief engineer during the building of Durotar and Orgrimmar.

sections.title: The Mastermind of Ratchet
sections.body: At Ratchet, Monte Gazlowe runs a port where rivals can trade under the Steamwheedle Cartel. He founded the town on the barren coast after earning a handsome payday for his engineering work with the new Horde. Horde, Alliance, and independent traders may barter there, so long as they keep their weapons sheathed and their purses heavy.

sections.title: Engineer for the Horde
sections.body: After the Third War, Warchief Thrall hired Monte Gazlowe as Durotar’s chief engineer to solve urgent problems for the new orc capital. Gazlowe took on the dangerous work of securing freshwater for Orgrimmar. His tunnels broke into underground kobold dens, but the wandering beastmaster Rexxar arrived in time to help blast the caverns shut. Gazlowe finished his assignments and remains a favored contractor and friend to Thrall. He has even sent his foreman, Rezlak, to keep helping with orc construction across Durotar.

sections.title: Trouble on the Merchant Coast
sections.body: Trade brings good earnings to Ratchet, but maritime rivals and thieves trouble Monte Gazlowe’s business. The Southsea Freebooters have camps along the nearby Merchant Coast, where they seize cargo bound for Ratchet and steal goods from raw ore to Gazlowe’s custom-ordered boots. To protect his profits, the port boss often hires passing sellswords of any allegiance to clear pirate camps, recover stolen shipments, and settle scores with troublemakers at the docks.

faq.answer: Monte Gazlowe runs Ratchet, the main trading port on the Barrens coast. He made his fortune as the chief engineer overseeing Orgrimmar’s construction, then founded Ratchet as an open, neutral harbor under the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.q: Is Gazlowe loyal to the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Monte Gazlowe operates Ratchet under the Steamwheedle Cartel and opens its docks to Alliance and Horde travelers. He also shares a close bond and a profitable history with Warchief Thrall, having engineered key parts of Durotar’s settlements.

faq.q: What did Gazlowe build in Durotar?
faq.answer: During Durotar’s founding, Warchief Thrall hired Monte Gazlowe as his chief engineer. Gazlowe oversaw tunnels dug to find an underground water supply for Orgrimmar. When the miners unleashed hostile kobolds, Gazlowe hired Rexxar to help sappers seal the tunnels.

faq.q: Why is Gazlowe hiring adventurers in Ratchet?
faq.answer: Monte Gazlowe hires private muscle against the Southsea Freebooters, who camp along the Merchant Coast and plunder cargo meant for Ratchet’s docks. He pays bounty hunters to eliminate the pirates, recover stolen cargo manifests, and retrieve missing shipments.

faq.q: What is Gazlowe's connection to the Mirage Raceway?
faq.answer: Monte Gazlowe is an avid admirer of engineering and speed. He sponsors goblin teams racing gnomes in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, helped build their racing rig, and is trying to find prototype fuel regulators.

angles.text: Gazlowe asks for your coin like any goblin, yet he has been a steadfast ally of Thrall since the Third War. He helped dig the foundations of your capital.
Gazlowe cares little for Stormwind’s throne or the quarrels you bring from the Eastern Kingdoms. Ratchet welcomes you if your gold is real and your blade stays sheathed.
Gazlowe is one of Kalimdor’s leading goblin engineers. He coordinates projects from city water grids to high-speed racing rigs at the Mirage Raceway.
Orgrimmar’s water supply came from tunnels dug by Gazlowe’s sappers. He still stations goblin mechanics in Durotar to help with heavy construction.
